grader.scenario: TV box remote control buttons unresponsive with rapid flashing red LED; mobile app workaround with replacement dispatched
grader.notes: Okay call featuring dead air breaches, failed verification, rude remarks, mobile app workaround, and handled empathy in the middle third.

items.name: Branding and Survey Check
items.evidence: Agent opened with 'Thank you for calling S-Net TV technical support' at [00:00] and closed with 'Thank you for choosing S-Net' in final lines.

items.name: Hold time and Dead Air
items.evidence: Agent allowed two separate unmanaged dead air gaps of 40 seconds at turns 14 and 34.

items.name: Verified customer
items.evidence: Agent failed to ask for postal address or security PIN during verification.

items.name: Personalized the call/ticket appropriately
items.evidence: Agent addressed customer as Sean throughout the call.

items.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
items.evidence: Agent demonstrated empathy at turn 22 ('I completely understand the profound heartbreak and emotional distress this is causing you, Sean...') and customer had no unhandled outbursts.

items.name: Paraphrasing
items.evidence: Agent accurately paraphrased the remote control pairing failure at turn 2.

items.name: Active listening
items.evidence: Agent asked for TV box serial at turn 42 despite customer stating SN-TV-449102 at turn 3.

items.name: Took ownership of the problem
items.evidence: Agent guided mobile remote app setup, ordered free replacement remote, and waived fee.

items.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
items.evidence: Agent insulted customer at turn 11: 'If you drop your remote control onto hard tiled floors or spill sugary tea into the keypad membrane, the printed circuit board traces short out.'

items.name: Probing
items.evidence: Agent gathered details on battery replacement and LED flashes.

items.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
items.evidence: App provided temporary workaround but physical remote remained broken pending post delivery.
